title: How anti-theft tags work - magnetostriction
summary: Applied Science explains how retail anti-theft tags work. A tiny magnetostrictive strip acts as a mechanical oscillator excited by a magnetic field, and magnetizing or demagnetizing it arms or disarms the tag.
why: HN recommends it as an informative explanation of what those tags are, especially in threads about implants and RFID.
